cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Draw another parade route with me. Two streets said no. You used to give up at the first line I crossed out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've found a line we can keep. Put in the loading bay. Who might stand there and cheer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would come. He works there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Draw him in. Not that tiny—remember, people matter more than kerbs on these plans. Leave room beside him. Who might he bring?

reason: Use specific familiar feedback and old pupil habits to shape the exact pursuit, without attributing every obstacle to a deliberate test. B actual contribution must change the next request.
